about: Findings that `bun run fuzz:ci` (seeds 1..500) still produces on master; test/fuzz/README.md explains the gate. Each entry names the open issue or PR that tracks it and lists the seeds it fires on. An entry matches a finding on status, errorName, the file of its top library frame and a message prefix, and only covers the seeds it lists: the same error on any other seed counts as new. Delete an entry when its fix lands; the run prints a note once an entry or some of its seeds stop reproducing.

findings.message: Invalid value used as weak map key
findings.example: a $ref to a boolean schema: {"definitions": {"A": false}, "items": [{"allOf": [{"$ref": "#/definitions/A"}]}]}. Fix proposed in PR 809.

findings.message: Refs should have been resolved by the resolver!
findings.example: a definition that is only a $ref to itself, kept alive by unreachableDefinitions or reached through another $ref: {"definitions": {"A": {"$ref": "#/definitions/A"}}} with {unreachableDefinitions: true}. PR 804 turns this into a deliberate ReferenceError; when it lands this entry becomes one for that error, same seeds.
